This is where tokenized stocks start to get interesting

@0xbeans proposes splitting one tokenized share into two tradable tokens: 

1) one capturing overnight price moves
2) the other regular trading session moves

A similar idea to Pendle splitting principal and yield, applied to WHEN a stock generates its returns

The two windows can behave very differently, so separating them could let investors trade overnight earnings exposure, hedge specific periods and build DeFi strategies around either leg

Both tokens together remain redeemable for the underlying share

Still an early proposal, but a useful example of how programmable stocks could create entirely new markets around familiar assets

We’ve already seen a plethora of value accrue to STANDARD charter holders, I’d hazard a guess there’s a lot more to come

We’re still in the early innings of what’s possible with tokenized stocks, and if you believe Robinhood will be the leader then there’s some pretty clear winners emerging that are worth tracking closely
